# Snake Game Specification

## 1. Project Overview
- **Project Name**: Classic Snake Game
- **Type**: HTML5 Canvas Game
- **Core Functionality**: Classic snake game with modern UI, smooth animations, and responsive design
- **Target Users**: Casual gamers looking for nostalgic gameplay

## 2. UI/UX Specification

### Layout Structure
- **Container**: Centered game container, max-width 600px
- **Header**: Game title with retro arcade styling
- **Score Display**: Current score prominently displayed
- **Game Canvas**: Main game area with grid background
- **Controls Info**: Keyboard controls hint at bottom
- **Game Over Overlay**: Modal with final score and restart button

### Visual Design
- **Color Palette**:
  - Background: `#0a0a0f` (deep dark)
  - Game board: `#12121a` (dark blue-gray)
  - Grid lines: `#1a1a25` (subtle grid)
  - Snake head: `#00ff88` (neon green)
  - Snake body: Gradient from `#00cc6a` to `#008844` (green gradient)
  - Food: `#ff3366` (neon pink) with glow effect
  - Score text: `#00ff88` (neon green)
  - Title: `#ff3366` (neon pink)
  - UI accents: `#00d4ff` (cyan)

- **Typography**:
  - Title: "Press Start 2P" (Google Font) - retro arcade style
  - Score: "Orbitron" (Google Font) - futuristic digital
  - Body: "Orbitron"

- **Spacing**:
  - Container padding: 20px
  - Element gaps: 15px

- **Visual Effects**:
  - Neon glow on title and score (text-shadow)
  - Pulsing food animation
  - Snake body gradient with subtle glow
  - Smooth snake movement (interpolated)
  - Game over fade-in overlay

### Components
- **Game Canvas**: 400x400px default, responsive
- **Score Display**: Large digital-style number
- **Start/Restart Button**: Neon styled button with hover glow
- **Game Over Modal**: Semi-transparent overlay with centered content
- **Keyboard hints**: Subtle text showing WASD/Arrow controls

### Responsive Breakpoints
- Desktop: Canvas 400x400px
- Tablet (< 600px): Canvas 350x350px
- Mobile (< 400px): Canvas 280x280px

## 3. Functionality Specification

### Core Features
1. **Snake Movement**
   - Continuous movement in current direction
   - Direction change via Arrow keys or WASD
   - Cannot reverse direction (no 180° turns)
   - Speed: 15 FPS (configurable)

2. **Food System**
   - Random food placement on grid
   - Food cannot spawn on snake body
   - Score +10 per food eaten
   - Snake grows by 1 segment when eating

3. **Collision Detection**
   - Wall collision: Game over
   - Self collision: Game over
   - Food collision: Score increase, grow snake

4. **Game States**
   - Ready: Initial state, press any key to start
   - Playing: Active gameplay
   - Game Over: Show final score, restart option

5. **Controls**
   - Arrow Keys: Up/Down/Left/Right
   - WASD: Alternative controls
   - Enter/Space: Start/Restart game

### User Interactions
- Keyboard input for direction
- Click/tap restart button
- Responsive to window resize

### Edge Cases
- Prevent food spawning on snake
- Prevent rapid direction changes causing self-collision
- Handle window resize gracefully

## 4. Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Game loads without errors
- [ ] Snake moves smoothly in all 4 directions
- [ ] Food appears randomly and is eatable
- [ ] Score updates in real-time
- [ ] Game ends on wall collision
- [ ] Game ends on self collision
- [ ] Game over screen shows final score
- [ ] Restart button works correctly
- [ ] Responsive on mobile devices
- [ ] 60 FPS smooth animation
- [ ] Retro neon visual style applied
- [ ] Code has clear comments

# Snake Game Specification

## 1. Project Overview
- **Project Name**: Classic Snake Game
- **Type**: HTML5 Canvas Game
- **Core Functionality**: Classic snake game with keyboard/touch controls, food eating, collision detection
- **Target Users**: Casual gamers on desktop and mobile

## 2. Visual & Rendering Specification

### Scene Setup
- Canvas size: 400x400px (responsive scaling)
- Grid: 20x20 cells, each cell 20px
- Background: Dark theme with subtle gradient

### Color Palette
- Background: #0f0f23 (deep dark blue)
- Game board: #1a1a2e (dark purple-gray)
- Grid lines: #2a2a4a (subtle)
- Snake head: #00ff88 (neon green)
- Snake body: Gradient from #00ff88 to #00aa55
- Food: #ff6b6b (coral red) with glow effect
- Score text: #ffffff
- UI accents: #00ff88

### Visual Effects
- Snake movement: Smooth grid-based animation
- Food: Pulsing glow animation
- Game over: Screen shake + fade overlay
- Score update: Pop animation
- Background: Subtle animated gradient

## 3. Game Mechanics

### Snake Behavior
- Initial length: 3 segments
- Initial position: Center-left of board
- Initial direction: Right
- Speed: 150ms per move (adjustable)
- Growth: +1 segment per food eaten

### Food System
- Random spawn on empty cells
- Only one food at a time
- New food spawns immediately after eating

### Collision Detection
- Wall collision: Game over
- Self collision: Game over
- Food collision: Score + grow

### Scoring
- +10 points per food
- High score stored in localStorage

## 4. Interaction Specification

### Controls
- **Desktop**: Arrow keys or WASD
- **Mobile**: On-screen directional buttons (up/down/left/right)
- **Touch areas**: Bottom of screen, 4 directional buttons

### Game States
1. **Start**: Title screen with "Press any key or tap to start"
2. **Playing**: Active gameplay
3. **Game Over**: Overlay with final score and restart button

## 5. UI Elements

### Score Display
- Current score (top-left)
- High score (top-right)
- Font: Monospace, bold

### Mobile Controls
- 4 arrow buttons in D-pad layout
- Semi-transparent, positioned at bottom
- Touch-responsive with visual feedback

### Game Over Screen
- Semi-transparent dark overlay
- "Game Over" title
- Final score display
- High score display
- "Play Again" button with hover effect

## 6. Technical Requirements

### Performance
- RequestAnimationFrame for game loop
- 60fps target
- Efficient collision detection

### Responsive Design
- Canvas scales to fit viewport (max 400px)
- Mobile controls appear on touch devices
- Maintains aspect ratio

### Code Structure
- Single HTML file
- Embedded CSS and JavaScript
- Clear comments throughout
- Modular functions for game logic

## 7. Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Snake moves smoothly in 4 directions
- [ ] Snake grows when eating food
- [ ] Score updates in real-time
- [ ] Game ends on wall/self collision
- [ ] Game over screen shows final score
- [ ] Restart button works correctly
- [ ] Mobile touch controls functional
- [ ] High score persists across sessions
- [ ] Animations are smooth and polished

游戏已创建完成：`/home/ubuntu/snake.html`

## 主要功能列表

| 功能 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **经典玩法** | 贪吃蛇经典规则：吃食物增长，撞墙/撞自己结束 |
| **双控制** | 支持方向键 ↑↓←→ 和 WASD 按键 |
| **实时计分** | 吃掉食物 +10 分，分数动态显示 |
| **最高分存储** | 使用 localStorage 保存最高分 |
| **游戏状态** | 就绪 → 进行中 → 游戏结束，完整状态管理 |
| **碰撞检测** | 墙壁碰撞 + 自身碰撞检测 |
| **视觉效果** | 霓虹发光、食物脉冲动画、分数弹跳效果 |
| **响应式设计** | 适配桌面/平板/手机 (400/350/280px) |
| **60fps渲染** | 使用 requestAnimationFrame 实现流畅动画 |
| **复古UI** | Press Start 2P 字体 + 霓虹配色 |

## 视觉特色

- 深色渐变背景 + 霓虹绿/粉色主题
- 蛇头带眼睛和发光效果
- 食物带脉冲发光动画
- 游戏结束显示最终分数和新纪录提示

用浏览器打开 `snake.html` 即可游玩。
